name: Tarui (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tarui town emblem in white: a stepped cross-shaped device.
history: Municipal flag of Tarui, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 July 1962.

features.role: Tarui town emblem — a stepped cross-shaped device
